results.question: How many VIP customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vip_customer_count FROM customer WHERE activebool = true;

results.question: What is our late return rate?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date > r.rental_date + (f.rental_duration || ' days')::interval THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) END AS late_return_rate FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL;

results.question: What is our average order value?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_order_value FROM payment;

results.question: What was our catalog utilization in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rentals_2025 FROM rental WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM rental_date) = 2025;

results.question: What was our customer retention rate from 2024 to 2025?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN start_cnt=0 THEN NULL ELSE (retained_cnt::numeric/start_cnt) END AS retention_rate FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS start_cnt FROM customer WHERE create_date <= DATE '2024-12-31' ) s CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS retained_cnt FROM customer WHERE create_date <= DATE '2024-12-31' AND activebool = TRUE ) r;

results.question: How many churned customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS churned_customers FROM customer WHERE activebool = false;

results.question: Which film category is our best performer?
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY rental_count DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: What was our revenue per active title in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT f.title, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue_2025 FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.rental_date) = 2025 GROUP BY f.title

results.question: How many dormant titles do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dormant_titles FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id);

results.question: What was our year-over-year revenue growth in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN prev_year_rev = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (curr_year_rev - prev_year_rev)::numeric / prev_year_rev * 100 END AS yoy_growth_percent FROM ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM payment_date) = 2025 THEN amount END) AS curr_year_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM payment_date) = 2024 THEN amount END) AS prev_year_rev FROM payment ) sub;
